feeds.title: Rex Predator Academy Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date with RPA and learn all kinds of useful tips and tricks regarding predator trapping, predator management, deer and wildlife management, and much more! Learn how to trap coyotes and take back control of your hunting property when you become a member. Rex Predator Academy offers online courses to help you successfully trap wildlife predators like coyotes, bobcats, foxes, etc.

feeds.title: Predator Exclusives Blog
feeds.description: Predator Exclusives offers guided predator hunts in Arizona, which offers some of the most diverse predator hunting areas in the world. Whether you are wanting to learn from top predator hunting guides or you just want to experience predators coming to the call. We will help you achieve success on your guided predator hunting trip. It was built to offer the absolute best predator hunting experience for those wanting to excel in their predator hunting skills and experience true predator hunting action!
